title: Designing BERT for Convolutional Networks: Sparse and Hierarchical Masked Modeling (SparK)
mechanism: MIM for any CNN: sparse convolution over visible pixels and a hierarchical decoder.
adaptation: Benchmark's CNN in-domain MIM baseline row (R34 already run); the only open variant is ConvNeXt, covered by ConvNeXt V2 FCMAE.
min_experiment: None new; reuse the existing MIM100-PF runs as the benchmark row.
evidence: R: about +1.0 over contrastive and transformer MIM, up to +3.5 on detection / instance segmentation (ResNet, ConvNeXt).
prior_overlap: Closed: SparK-style MIM on ResNet-34, 11.9k pool, PF, 100% labels, n.d. (doc 11 row 25).

alt_notes.adaptation: Already run on R34 (n.d.); keep as the benchmark's CNN in-domain MIM row; only open variants are new targets (gradient, ridge) and new backbones.
alt_notes.min_experiment: None new; existing run is the benchmark row.
